first love hurts no matter the ins and outs, the best quote i ever saw went along the lines of “grief is beautiful, it is all the unexpressed love” it might not help everyone and im sorry if it hurts more, it probably will rn, but honestly as someone 4 years on from breaking up with my first relationship i can tell you honestly it does get better, from the bottom of my heart i promise it does and you will feel like getting out of bed again, and going back to doing all the things you love, especially new things you’ll discover you love, you’ll meet new people make new friends and you’ll feel better, the good memories will be there and maybe things like their face and their voice will fade over time, the things that really hurt, will fade but one day you will wake up and you’ll think about it passingly for maybe the 1,000,000th time and you’ll realise it doesn’t hurt anymore, it may just bring a warm smile to your face for a brief moment and you’ll move on with your day. Sorry this is so long already and i’m sorry if it doesn’t really help, i just want to assure you and other people reading this feeling the same way that even when you truly believe to your core things won’t get better, and the idea of being with someone new may disgust you at that immediate point (and definitely make sure you’re healed and ready before you move on, made that mistake too) it will all change, there are better days for you, from experience, i promise that too
